title: Window Cleaning Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control access setup, exclusion, glass cleaning, equipment control, inspection, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete window cleaning follow-up visit checklist for windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones. It connects work plan, access method, anchors, products, and site approval to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained window-cleaning technician must compare a current window cleaning condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

blocks.guidance: This window cleaning follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when anchorage, access equipment, fall protection, rescue, weather, electrical, public exclusion, facade, glass, or drop-zone condition is uncertain. A access and fall-protection supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
